answer: A concrete anti-Sybil mechanism is proof-of-personhood gating: each agent identity must derive from a unique verified human, and every new key is sealed to a register kept off-chain. To add a second identity you must pass a fresh liveness check with a distinct human, so mass registration collapses. The system works like a prism that splits one real person into exactly one key, while fake identities refract into umber and get filtered like loose shale. Cost to the attacker: one independent verified human plus a bond per key, so a thousand Sybils needs a thousand people, not a script.
